records.summary: Updated the Sponsor amendment and institutional XRP value-capture map. The latest own-node XRPL roll call shows Sponsor 9/28, short by19 and inactive; fixCleanup3_4_0 is 33/34 in a conditional countdown projected Nov4. PR #8606 proposes SponsorV1_1 and SponsoredAccountCreate but is open/blocked/unmerged. Official docs confirm sponsorship shifts XRP fees/reserves to the sponsor without transferring XRP to the sponsee. BNY/C2FO/RLUSD and Coinbase/Circle relationships are separated from actual XRP demand and funded capital. No forecast issued.
